faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Resume Booster

whatDoIGet.question: What do I get with Resume Booster?
whatDoIGet.answer: You get a comprehensive analysis including AI-ATS optimized bullet point rewrites, stronger action verb suggestions, keyword recommendations for your industry, and red flags that AI screeners and recruiters might notice. Everything is written in direct, actionable language.

howLong.question: How long does the analysis take?
howLong.answer: Your resume analysis is generated instantly after payment. You will see your results on the success page within seconds.

fileFormats.question: What file formats do you accept?
fileFormats.answer: We accept PDF files, Word documents (DOCX), and plain text. Simply upload your resume file or paste your resume text directly into the input field.

subscription.question: Is this a subscription?
subscription.answer: No. Resume Booster is a one-time payment of $25. There are no subscriptions, recurring charges, or upsells.

share.question: Can I share my analysis with others?
share.answer: Yes! After your analysis is complete, you can copy a shareable link to send to mentors, career coaches, or anyone you want feedback from.

whoWrites.question: Who writes the feedback?
whoWrites.answer: The feedback is generated by AI trained to think like a recruiter. It focuses on what actually matters in the hiring process, not generic career advice.

dataStorage.question: Do you store my resume data?
dataStorage.answer: No. We do not store or collect your resume content. Your resume is processed in real-time to generate your analysis, and then immediately discarded. We never retain your personal information.

vsChatGPT.question: Why is this better than ChatGPT or resume templates?
vsChatGPT.answer: Resume Booster uses AI to simulate how modern AI-powered ATS systems scan resumes, with a 5-category weighted scoring system, 14 industry-specific templates, and recruiter-calibrated feedback. Unlike ChatGPT, you get consistent 10-section structured output without prompt engineering. Unlike templates, we provide personalized rewrites, LinkedIn analysis, and job description alignment. Your data is immediately discarded—never used for training.

atsScore.title: AI-ATS Score
atsScore.description: Our AI simulates how modern AI-powered Applicant Tracking Systems scan your resume—the same technology 98% of Fortune 500 companies use.
atsScore.whyMatters: A low score means your resume may never reach a human recruiter.

format.title: Format Grade
format.description: Evaluates your resume's structure, layout, and AI-ATS readability.
format.whyMatters: Poor formatting causes AI-ATS parsing errors, losing your key information.

metrics.title: Quantification Score
metrics.description: Measures how many of your achievements include numbers, percentages, or metrics.
metrics.whyMatters: Recruiters spend 6 seconds scanning—numbers catch their eye first.

verbs.title: Action Verb Grade
verbs.description: Rates the strength and variety of action verbs starting your bullet points.
verbs.whyMatters: Strong verbs like 'Spearheaded' beat weak ones like 'Helped' or 'Assisted'.

pages.title: Resume Length
pages.description: Checks if your resume length matches industry standards for your experience level.
pages.whyMatters: Too long = skipped. Too short = lacking substance.

words.title: Word Count
words.description: Measures if you have enough content to showcase your value.
words.whyMatters: The sweet spot varies by experience—too few words signals inexperience.

sections.title: Section Check
sections.description: Verifies all essential resume sections are present (Summary, Experience, Education, Skills).
sections.whyMatters: Missing sections are immediate red flags for recruiters.

contact.title: Contact Info
contact.description: Checks for email, phone, and LinkedIn presence.
contact.whyMatters: Recruiters can't hire you if they can't contact you.

readability.title: Readability Score
readability.description: Measures how easy your resume is to scan quickly.
readability.whyMatters: Recruiters average 6-7 seconds per resume—make every word count.

bulletImpact.title: Bullet Impact
bulletImpact.description: Analyzes if your bullets focus on achievements vs. just listing responsibilities.
bulletImpact.whyMatters: Achievement-focused bullets prove value; responsibility lists don't.

keywordDensity.title: Keyword Density
keywordDensity.description: Measures industry-relevant keyword presence for AI-ATS matching.
keywordDensity.whyMatters: Too few keywords = no AI-ATS match. Too many = keyword stuffing penalty.

improvementPotential.title: Improvement Potential
improvementPotential.description: Estimated score increase possible with optimization.
improvementPotential.whyMatters: Shows how much room you have to outcompete other candidates.

industryBenchmark.title: Industry Benchmark
industryBenchmark.description: Compares your score against others in your field.
industryBenchmark.whyMatters: Know where you stand against your direct competition.

timeline.title: Career Timeline
timeline.description: Analyzes job tenure, gaps, and career progression patterns.
timeline.whyMatters: Recruiters look for stability and growth—gaps need explanation.

atsCompatibility.title: AI-ATS System Compatibility
atsCompatibility.description: Shows how well your resume parses across major AI-powered Applicant Tracking Systems like Workday, Greenhouse, and Taleo.
atsCompatibility.whyMatters: Different companies use different AI-ATS systems—know which ones will read your resume correctly.
